attributes.title: 2027 Workshop on Neonatal-Perinatal Practice Strategies
attributes.series: AAP Workshop on Neonatal-Perinatal Practice Strategies
attributes.summary:
Held at Loews Ventana Canyon in Tucson on February 5 to 7, 2027. A separate Neonatal Coding Seminar on the first day adds 4.75 CME credits for its morning portion, which may interest anyone who handles unit billing.

The AAP designates up to 17.75 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits, with matching AAPA and NAPNAP hours. The American Board of Pediatrics approves 10 MOC Part 2 points if the post-assessment is finished by March 7, 2027.

January 8, 2027 ends both the early rate and the $259 hotel block; cancellation requests are due January 22. Fee amounts sit in a PDF we did not verify, so none are listed here.
